findings.note: Retires the label-only `choice` picker the effect-backfill overlay authored on classFeatures/construct-innovation. supersedes:true — an overlay row for this exact category/id/field already exists (scripts/data/effect-backfill.json, flag 'constructModification', 7 label strings) and this row REPLACES it whole with null, which apply-backfill treats as 'delete the field'. Safe to delete because nothing reads it: grepping 'constructModification' across src/ and test/ returns zero hits, so the picker was a label with no reader. The three sibling innovations (armor-, weapon-, light-mortar-innovation) carry no `choice` at all — the tier pickers in src/builder/shared.tsx are the single carrier for all four, and batch 034's engine family already removed the `if (type === 'construct')` early return that hid them. ATOMIC with the 18 create rows below: applying this row alone would leave a construct inventor with no modification control at all.

backfillRows.why: AoN innovation-2: "Choose one initial construct modification to apply to your innovation, either from the following or from other initial construct modifications to which you have access." One choice, and print then names three TIERS of them (Initial, Breakthrough at 7th, Revolutionary at 15th). The record's own 7-label `choice` answered only the first tier, could never grow the other two, and rendered a SECOND control beside the tier pickers that now offer the real records — the same question asked twice, with two different answers stored in two places.

findings.note: The 18 modification records innovation-2 prints, tagged `construct-innovation-modification` so the existing generic reader picks them up: inventorModificationOptions (src/rules/build.ts:2753) filters classFeatures by `otherTags.includes('<type>-innovation-modification')` and `level <= tier level`, and src/builder/shared.tsx renders one PopupSelect per tier from it. No new reader, no new field — the lane is the one armour (22 records), weapon (26) and light mortar (9) already use, and the construct tag census was the only empty one. Record shape copied field-for-field from classFeatures/advanced-design (the weapon-innovation precedent, which is likewise a modification SECTION of an innovation page): aonParentId/aonSection rather than an aonId, because innovation-2 carries all 18 as sections and none has a page of its own. Ids: `advanced-weaponry-construct` is deliberately not the bare slug — feats/advanced-weaponry already holds it (a different bucket, so not a hard collision, but the disambiguated id keeps the two apart in every id-keyed table). `manual-dexterity` exists only in familiarAbilities, a different bucket with no shared id space. The other 16 are free everywhere. LABEL-ONLY on purpose: a chosen inventor modification is an ownedFeatureId (src/rules/derive.ts ownedFeatureIds — "The inventor's chosen INNOVATION MODIFICATIONS are class features too"), so a landSpeedBonus / senses / grants.skills / resistances authored here would apply to the INVENTOR, not to the construct. Their prose is a create row's companion and lives in work/.b034-created-desc-gap-engine.json.
